text:
maria: Heads up — after today's OOB firmware push to the eu-west GPU BMC pool (~02:10 UTC) about 15 nodes are failing provisioning. Symptoms: GPUs not coming online, some nodes reporting 'EFI Secure Boot: enabled' even though rollout metadata didn't flip secure boot. Serial consoles are noisy for a subset. Posting initial logs below.

jon: Can you paste the ipmitool output / a short dmesg/serial dump?

maria: ```
# ipmitool -H 10.24.5.67 -U admin -P **** sol info
Serial Over LAN: enabled
Active session: 2
Channels: IMPI v2.0

# journalctl -u provisioner | tail -n 20
Mar 07 02:11:22 provisioner[1234]: node eu-west-1-ux07: kernel: EFI: Secure Boot enabled
Mar 07 02:11:23 provisioner[1234]: node eu-west-1-ux07: gpu-manager: no GPUs found
```
One of the BMCs is spewing repeated IPMI sessions (seen in bmctool): ``Session storm from 10.24.5.67: auth fail``.

sam: Uh huh. This looks like NVRAM/efivar values got zeroed or vendor FW defaulted SecureBoot to enabled. We've seen a vendor image where efivars are rewritten on first boot. Any canary rollback run yet?

lena: Capacity impact: roughly 192 GPUs out of the eu-west pool are unavailable — batch queue backlog spiked and we pushed jobs to us-west which is adding ~+85% infra cost for the last 6h. Finance already pinged me.

maria: I kicked a canary rollback to the previous BMC image on 3 nodes (eu-west-1-ux02, -ux07, -ux09). So far two stabilized and GPUs came back. One node still has serial multiplex stuck and the sol session isn't responding.

deploy-bot: deploy/canary-bmc-rollback started by @maria — 3 nodes. status: in_progress

ops-bot: alert: oob_mgmt_fanout rate > threshold for eu-west-bmc — incident INC-4532 created

jon: If NVRAM got corrupted we can try to clear the problematic efivars over the serial console or vendor fwtool. Example (vendor-specific):
```
# ./scripts/efivar-reset.sh --host 10.24.5.67 --var SecureBoot
# ipmitool raw 0x3c 0x?? <vendor-arg>
```
Be careful — some vendors brick if you blindly clear key blobs.

maria: Agree. I ran a small helper to check efivar state, output from eu-west-1-ux07: ``SecureBoot=1, PK=empty, KEK=empty, db=empty`` — that matches a case where SecureBoot is on but no allowed keys -> boot rejects modules.

sam: Do not mass-clear NVRAM without vendor support. Suggest: 1) pause rollout, 2) expand canary to 10 nodes overnight, 3) attempt safe vendor-recommended efivar repair on 1 canary, 4) if repair is impossible, rollback FW for remainder. Also open vendor-support ticket and request escalation.

lena: Cost note for PMs/finance: autoscale to backfill backlog cost ~ $14k (last 6h). We'll need temporary chargeback if Dedicated customers were affected.

maria: @jon can you run `bmc-health-check --pool eu-west-gpu-bmc --filter unstable` and paste the output? I want a definitive list for the rollback runbook.

jon: ```
$ bmc-health-check --pool eu-west-gpu-bmc --filter unstable
eu-west-1-ux02: bmc_fw=v2.18 -> v2.21 (rolled back)
eu-west-1-ux07: bmc_fw=v2.18 -> v2.21 (stable)
eu-west-1-ux09: bmc_fw=v2.18 -> v2.21 (serial sol hung)
eu-west-1-ux11: bmc_fw=v2.21 (secureboot=1, PK=empty)
eu-west-1-ux13: bmc_fw=v2.21 (secureboot=1, nvram-corrupt)
... (total unstable 15)
```

maria: Plan for now: 1) pause further BMC rollouts immediately, 2) expand the rollback canary to 10 nodes overnight (low traffic window), 3) work with vendor on efivar handling/repair and RMA policy for any bricked boards, 4) route new provisioning requests away from nodes with v2.21. I'll author a short runbook and link it in INC-4532.

sam: Also add a release gate: verify efivar invariants (PK/KEK/db presence or explicit disabled state) before marking a node healthy. Add an automated preflight that fails the rollout if efivars are inconsistent.

maria: +1. I'll add the check to the rollout pipeline and make the change non-optional for future BMC images. tagging @infra-oncall to handle overnight.

infra-oncall: Acknowledged. I'll monitor INC-4532 and coordinate rollback ops. If vendor approves, we'll run a single efivar repair on a canary node with console attached.

ops-bot: incident INC-4532 updated: mitigation started — partial rollback in progress.

maria: Thanks all. I'll follow up with the incident doc and the cost impact summary. If anyone sees unexpected re-rollouts from the CI system, please @maria immediately. :grimacing:
